column2: Rate each element 0-10 using the scoring guide. Total score indicates GEO readiness.

column4: 0-3: Template "[Service] in [City]" | 4-6: Some uniqueness but similar structure | 7-10: Completely unique, mentions neighborhood + specialty
0-3: Same as title or generic template | 4-6: Slightly differentiated | 7-10: Unique, impossible to reuse on other pages
0-3: Generic, no local references | 4-6: Mentions city name only | 7-10: References specific streets, landmarks, local history
0-3: <30% unique content | 4-6: 30-50% unique | 7-10: >50% unique content vs other location pages
0-3: No named person | 4-6: Generic bio, no local ties | 7-10: Named person with local credentials, assigned to this area
0-3: "John D." style, no details | 4-6: Full names but no location | 7-10: Full names + specific streets/neighborhoods + dates
0-3: None | 4-6: Generic examples | 7-10: Specific local project with address, metrics, outcomes
0-3: "City and surrounding areas" | 4-6: Lists neighborhoods | 7-10: Specific streets, landmarks, transit stops, micro-geo signals
0-3: No CTA in first fold | 4-6: Text link only | 7-10: Prominent button with clear action in hero section
0-3: No pricing at all | 4-6: "Call for quote" only | 7-10: Specific price ranges for common services
0-3: None | 4-6: Generic FAQs | 7-10: Location-specific questions with detailed, local answers
0-3: Contact page link only | 4-6: Phone number somewhere | 7-10: Phone + address + hours prominently displayed
0-3: None | 4-6: Basic schema, missing fields | 7-10: Complete with address, geo, hours, areaServed neighborhoods
0-3: None | 4-6: Basic service type only | 7-10: Full schema with pricing, offers, service area
0-3: None | 4-6: Schema present but generic Qs | 7-10: Schema with location-specific Q&As
0-3: None | 4-6: Rating without review count | 7-10: Full rating with review count, linked to real reviews
